title: Reflex: GGUF-native cold-start classifier and chat (12 models)
description: Zero-shot classification, intent routing and OpenAI-compatible chat on scale-to-zero GPU endpoints, backed by Reflex: a GGUF-native engine that compiles its CUDA kernels ahead of time (no runtime JIT), so a cold worker reaches its first result fast. POST /v1/classify scores every label as a continuation of the prompt in one prefill and returns each label's probability within the set plus the entropy -- nothing is generated, so a decision is one forward pass, not a decode loop. Chat completions stream or not. Pick the model when you deploy: Qwen3 0.6B (default, baked into the image), 1.7B, 4B or 8B; Qwen2.5 1.5B or 7B Instruct; TinyLlama 1.1B Chat; Mistral 7B Instruct; Qwen3.5 0.8B; Granite 4.0-H 350M or 1B; Gemma 4 12B (24 GB GPU). Any model but the default is downloaded when a worker starts (attach a network volume to keep it across workers), or give your own GGUF URL. On Runpod, cold Reflex was ~42-44s vs the official vLLM worker's ~150s (same GPU tier/day; vLLM also pulled bf16 weights; endpoint types differed) -- most of both is platform provisioning; Reflex's own engine load was ~1.6s. batch_size is always 1 -- steady high-QPS chat wants vLLM. Guide: https://github.com/lateos-ai/reflex/blob/master/.runpod/README.md

input.name: Model
input.description: The GGUF to serve. Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 is baked into the image (fastest cold start). Any other choice is downloaded from Hugging Face when a worker starts (size in its label): once per worker, or once in all with a network volume attached. Gemma 4 12B needs a 24 GB GPU, not the 16 GB pool.

options.label: Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 (baked in, default; best for classification)
Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M, hybrid Gated DeltaNet (0.5 GB download)
Granite 4.0-H 350M Q8_0, Mamba-2 hybrid (0.4 GB download)
Granite 4.0-H 1B Q8_0, Mamba-2 hybrid (1.6 GB download)
Gemma 4 12B-it Q8_0 (12.7 GB download, 24 GB GPU)

input.name: Custom GGUF URL
input.description: Overrides Model: a direct URL to any GGUF of an architecture Reflex supports, e.g. https://huggingface.co/<owner>/<repo>/resolve/main/<file>.gguf. It must fit the GPU and the container disk. Supported architectures and their limits: https://github.com/lateos-ai/reflex#supported-models-and-limits

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Only for a gated or private Hugging Face repo in Custom GGUF URL. Sent only to huggingface.co.

input.name: Adapter Arguments
input.description: Extra reflex-openai-adapter flags, space-separated, e.g. "--max-tokens-cap 1024 --default-max-tokens 128". Request limits default to max_tokens 2048, prompt 256 KiB, queue depth 16, timeout 300 s.
